info.name: FPL Intelligence — External APIs
info.description:
Every third-party/external HTTP API the fpl-intelligence repo calls out to (as of 2026-08-24). Internal `/api/*` endpoints served BY this repo's own dashboard server are intentionally excluded — this collection only covers outbound calls this codebase makes to other services.

Folders are organized one-to-one with the source file that makes the calls:
- `src/fpl_intel/sources/fpl_data.py` — official FPL bootstrap/fixtures/live data
- `src/fpl_intel/sources/manager_data.py` — public FPL manager entry data
- `src/fpl_intel/sources/pl_transfers.py` — Premier League transfer-centre playlist API
- `src/fpl_intel/sources/news_signals.py` — Anthropic Claude API + generic OpenAI-compatible LLM API (Phase 5, gated/not active in production)

Note: the repo also sends email via SMTP (`src/fpl_intel/notifications/*.py`, configured through `FPL_INTEL_SMTP_*` / `FPL_INTEL_SERVER_SMTP_*` env vars). SMTP isn't an HTTP API so it has no Postman request, but it's listed here for completeness.

variable.description: Any public FPL manager entry (team) ID
PL content playlist ID. 4658365 is the master transfer-centre playlist; per-team playlist IDs are discovered from its response.
FPL_INTEL_LLM_API_BASE — set to whatever OpenAI-compatible host you're pointing at. Not a real endpoint; placeholder only.

item.name: fpl_data.py
item.description: Official, unauthenticated FPL API calls for core dataset, fixtures, and live gameweek stats. urllib.request with a descriptive User-Agent, no API key. src/fpl_intel/sources/fpl_data.py

request.description: Core FPL dataset: all players (elements), teams, positions (element_types), gameweeks (events), prices, availability. fetch_bootstrap().
All season fixtures with kickoff times and FDR. fetch_fixtures().
Live per-player stats for a single gameweek. fetch_event_live().

item.name: manager_data.py
item.description: Public FPL manager entry data — no credentials required, everything here is publicly exposed by the official API. urllib.request with User-Agent 'fpl-intelligence/1.0'. src/fpl_intel/sources/manager_data.py

request.description: Public manager profile: name, overall rank/points, current event, bank/value. collect_public_manager().
Manager's season-by-season and per-gameweek history, plus chips used. collect_public_manager().
All transfers a manager has made this season. collect_public_manager().
Manager's published squad picks (11+subs, captain, chip) for one gameweek. Used both for the current event (collect_public_manager()) and any past event (fetch_manager_event_picks()).

item.name: pl_transfers.py
item.description: Official Premier League transfer-centre content, used to derive confirmed transfers/loans. urllib.request with User-Agent 'FPL Intelligence local dashboard', no API key. src/fpl_intel/sources/pl_transfers.py

request.description: The master playlist (fixed ID 4658365) lists one child playlist per club — 'Transfer Centre' items. fetch_confirmed_transfers().

Per-club playlist of transfer-in/out/loan/release items, each tagged with a movement type and a source link. `{{playlist_id}}` here should be one of the child IDs returned by the master playlist call, not the master ID itself. fetch_confirmed_transfers().

item.name: news_signals.py
item.description: Phase 5 scaffolding (gated, NOT wired into the live refresh pipeline): extracts structured player-availability signals from first-party news text via an LLM. Provider is selected by FPL_INTEL_LLM_PROVIDER ('claude' default, or 'openai_compatible'). src/fpl_intel/sources/news_signals.py

request.description: Key from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var. Model is pinned to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. _call_claude().

Generic caller for any host implementing the OpenAI Chat Completions shape. Base URL, model, and key all come from env vars (FPL_INTEL_LLM_API_BASE, FPL_INTEL_LLM_MODEL, FPL_INTEL_LLM_API_KEY) — nothing is hardcoded. _call_openai_compatible().
